sources.title: Utfall kostnadsutjämning och LSS-utjämning 2023
sources.access: Primary SKR PDF text read through web tool; original bytes not archived.
sources.locator: Printed pages 1–3 and 5; PDF zero-based pages 2–4 and 6
sources.evidence: Administrative2023 equalisation values were announced in December2022. LSS uses October2021 services, RS2021 costs, a personnel-cost index and updated November2022 population. Revised inflation assumptions affect the calculation. The circular names municipal workbook Prognosunderlag K-2022–2029-22058 and SCB tables, but does not print Motala's amounts.
sources.nextSource: Recover original SCB December2022 municipal tables or the2258 workbook, with code0583, exact release and units. An announced administrative2023 amount is distinct from a later2023 annual-account outcome.

sources.title: Slutligt utfall av 2021 års kommunala fastighetsavgift samt prognos för åren 2022, 2023 och 2024
sources.access: SKR host returned a web error; full primary PDF text read from the publisher mirror. Original bytes not archived.
sources.locator: Cover and printed pages 1–5; PDF zero-based pages 0 and 2–6
sources.evidence: Annex1 contains municipal amounts; annex5 describes recognised2022 income; annex6 payments; annex7 receivables. Recognised income includes a correction of the preceding year's estimate when its final amount arrives. The circular also discloses an error in the earlier21:52 forecast, corrected later. Preserve the original historical vintage rather than replacing it with that later correction.
sources.nextSource: Recover annex1 and5–7 for code0583. Separate current-year estimated fee, prior-year correction and cash. A note7 total cannot automatically serve as the prior year's isolated current-fee estimate. Annex5's standard correction assumes the municipality used the specified earlier forecast; verify Motala's booked estimate or explicitly label that assumption before using the correction.

sources.title: Slutligt utfall av 2022 års kommunala fastighetsavgift samt prognos för åren 2023, 2024 och 2025
sources.access: Primary SKR PDF text read through web tool; original bytes not archived.
sources.evidence: The current-fee2024 forecast uses municipal small-house valuation projections and revises the previous method. Annex1 columnsAG,AI,AK,AM refer to2022,2023,2024,2025 amounts. Prior-year correction enters recognised income separately.2024 payments differ from2024 income; the2022 receivable is settled during2024. The municipal figures were to enter the following23:62 workbook.
sources.nextSource: Recover dated annex1 and5–7 or original23:62 workbook. Distinguish tax/fee period, recognition year, payment year and publication date before any scoring.

limitations: These discoveries do not change any frozen source, forecast or score. No missing Motala amount has been inferred from annual accounts or national percentage changes.

Late-December documents postdate the specific vintages selected in v8 but precede its year-end macro cutoff. A future experiment must explicitly revise the locked source-selection rule across all origins, for example the latest documented release per component by December31. The cutoff need not change. No outcome-selected replacement for2022 or2023 is permitted.

Reading a dated circular proves its stated administrative calculation and release context, not retrieval of its missing municipal workbook or real-time availability of opening accounts. A standard prior-year correction also requires verification of the estimate actually booked by Motala; a publisher's assumed earlier forecast is not automatically that local estimate.

Targeted searches did not recover the original municipal attachments. A secondary2025 LSS table was only a lead; its failed primary link and subsequently updated article do not establish an original forecast vintage.

The programme composition and decision dates behind otherGeneralGrants remain unresolved, including the increase from21 to51 in the2025 report. No category transfer or replacement amount is inferred from this difference.
